description: Java class for the device connection AMQP endpoint within the Eclipse Hono framework, handling device connection requests over AMQP 1.0 and interacting with an event bus.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionAmqpEndpoint
classes.description: Handles device connection requests received via AMQP, creating and sending event bus messages, and generating AMQP responses.

methods.name: DeviceConnectionAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing the endpoint with a Vertx instance.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this endpoint.

methods.name: getEventBusServiceAddress
methods.description: Provides the address on the event bus for device connection messages.

methods.name: createEventBusRequestMessage
methods.description: Creates an EventBusMessage from an AMQP request message, target address, and client principal.

methods.name: passesFormalVerification
methods.description: Checks if the message passes verification criteria.

methods.name: getAmqpReply
methods.description: Generates an AMQP reply message based on processing results.
